## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and the full suite passes (`bin/run pytest`)
- [ ] `bin/run lint` is clean (ruff + the file-size gate)
- [ ] Nothing writes to a source file — the three writers still write new files only
- [ ] A decode change is backed by a real file or by Rig Manager agreeing, not by a plausible-looking offset
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (`README.md`, `docs/`, `--help`, `CHANGELOG.md`)
- [ ] No backup, pack or `.krig` attached or committed, and no names, counts or paths from a real library in code, tests or docs
